body.message:
Good afternoon BPO | KPO,

We sincerely apologize for the confusion regarding the rate shared earlier. We would like to inform you that there has been a small correction to the quoted rate.

The previously shared rate of AED 7,500 was applicable only for the month of July. Since we are now approaching the end of July and your check-in is planned for 31st July or 1st August, the rate has been updated based on the current availability and market conditions.

We truly appreciate your understanding and apologize for any inconvenience this adjustment may cause. We will share the updated rates with you shortly.

Thank you for your patience and cooperation.
